INSERT INTO orders ( order_number, member_id, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, cancellation_blocked_at, payment_expires_at, request_message ) VALUES ( #{orderNumber}, #{memberId}, #{orderType}, #{ordererName},
#{ordererPhone}, #{pickupName}, #{pickupPhone}, #{originalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{status}, #{pickupAt}, #{cancellationBlockedAt}, #{paymentExpiresAt}, #{requestMessage} )

INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_type, quantity, base_price, option_amount, total_amount, requirements, preparation_days, cancellation_limit_days ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{quantity}, #{basePrice}, #{optionAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{requirements}, #{preparationDays}, #{cancellationLimitDays} )

INSERT INTO order_item_options ( order_item_id, product_option_id, option_group_name, option_name, additional_price ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{productOptionId}, #{optionGroupName}, #{optionName}, #{additionalPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_number, member_id, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, cancellation_blocked_at, payment_expires_at, request_message, reject_reason, under_review_at, rejected_at, rejected_by, ready_at, approved_by, picked_up_at, picked_up_by, expired_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, canceled_by, pickup_reminder_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT id, order_id, product_id, product_name, product_type, quantity, base_price, option_amount, total_amount, requirements, preparation_days, cancellation_limit_days FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id

SELECT oio.id, oio.order_item_id, oio.product_option_id, oio.option_group_name, oio.option_name, oio.additional_price FROM order_item_options oio INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = oio.order_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id, oio.id

SELECT oii.id, oii.order_item_id, oii.image_url, oii.sort_order FROM order_item_images oii INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = oii.order_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id, oii.sort_order, oii.id
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'UNDER_REVIEW', under_review_at = #{underReviewAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', ready_at = #{readyAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'GENERAL' AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', approved_by = #{approvedBy}, ready_at = #{readyAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'REJECTED', rejected_by = #{rejectedBy}, rejected_at = #{rejectedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'CANCELED' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'PICKED_UP', picked_up_by = #{pickedUpBy}, picked_up_at = #{pickedUpAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders AS current_order LEFT JOIN payments AS payment ON payment.order_id = current_order.id AND payment.status IN ('READY', 'DONE') SET current_order.status = 'EXPIRED', current_order.expired_at = #{expiredAt}, payment.status = 'EXPIRED', payment.provider_status = 'EXPIRED', payment.failure_code = 'ORDER_EXPIRED', payment.failure_message = '주문 결제 제한 시간이 지났습니다.' WHERE current_order.id = #{orderId} AND current_order.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND (payment.id IS NULL OR payment.status = 'READY')

UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_by = #{canceledBy}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, canceled_at = #{canceledAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'CANCELED' ) AND ( (order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW') OR ( order_type = 'GENERAL' AND status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' AND #{canceledAt} < pickup_at ) )
